abstract.text: Interface to the FIDO2/CTAP authenticator on the YubiKey.

inlineContent.text: Use the FIDO2 session to interact with the CTAP authenticator for WebAuthn/FIDO2
operations like credential creation, authentication, and device information.

optional features like credential management and biometric enrollment.
